decisions.reason: After four years in a niche the firm knows well, the resin injection unit costs little to hold, and the missing 2020-2021 evidence does not clearly show it has failed, so the option stays open.
Overlap with A makes this unit the more likely candidate for consolidation, but without clear negative results keeping it remains cheaper than abandoning it.
Automatic airless guns share components with the core pump range and support system sales, so their holding cost is minimal and their value is largely confirmed.
A manual airless gun is a staple accessory that complements the established business, so there is no reason to give up this low-cost option.
The multi-model air-assisted line may be pruned at the variant level, but abandoning the whole line is unlikely given its fit with the coating business.
Demand for quality documentation in coating keeps the data logger's digital value plausible, so the cheap option is kept despite the risk of a successor model replacing it.
